title: 第451章 当场血崩第450章 子宫癌
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
顿了顿，王玉婷接着说道：“而且咱们医院好几次差点发生医疗事故，都是我爸爸请赵大爷前来救场，才避免事故发生的。所以赵大爷和咱们医院关系特别好，医院里的好多医生护士都认识他，也很尊敬他。”
见王玉婷的表情那么认真，一点也不像撒谎，周心蓝这才终于点点头说道：“好吧，我就给你一个面子，不和他吵了。”
可随后，周心蓝又说道：“但是他想在这里给李婉容治疗子宫癌，这肯定是不行的！他不是咱们医院的医生，按规矩不能在咱们医院里行医，否则出了问题怎么办，他承担责任还是我承担责任？”
似乎早就猜到周心蓝不会同意赵大柱在这里治病救人，于是王玉婷笑着说道：“我刚刚就给我爸爸发过消息了，他应该马上就要来了，他来了以后这里当然就是他负责，你就什么都不用管了。”
果然，王玉婷话音刚落，就有一个穿着白大褂的老者从外面走了进来。
这个老者不是别人，正是桃花县中心医院的院长王远纪！
“我来承担！”
王远纪刚刚进入病房就大声说道，然后就笑哈哈的加快脚步朝着赵大柱走来。
“赵大爷你怎么来的时候招呼也不打一声呢，我要是知道你来我这里，我就下去亲自迎接你了！”王远纪爽朗的笑着说道。
赵大柱笑道：“我又不是来找你喝茶叙旧的，而是来你这里给病人检查治疗的，治好她以后我还得早点回家呢，所以就没想打扰你。”
“没办法啊，我是院长，医院里的大事小事都由我来负责，你就是不想打扰我都不行。”
王远纪呵呵一笑接着说道：“赵大爷你现在就可以放手给这位女患者治疗，这里发生的一切事情都有我这个院长来承担责任，赵大爷你什么都不用担心。”
“院长你……”
周心蓝想要阻止，但王远纪立即转过头对周心蓝说道：“周主任你不要老是跟上司对着干行不行，你在兰花市人民医院干不下去不就是因为你跟顶头上司闹崩了？我这个院长都说了一切责任我来承担，你就别操心了！”
如果是别的医生肯定就点头答应了，可这个周心蓝竟然倔强的很，毫不避讳的说道：“现在没出事你当然这么说，等真的出事了，你就要把我这个肿瘤科主任踢出去背黑锅了！”
“你！”
王远纪气的浑身发抖，脸色都变得铁青。
王玉婷苦笑连连，连忙说道：“爸，你别生气，心蓝是什么样的人你又不是不清楚，而且她没有恶意的，她只是心里想什么嘴上就说什么而已。”
王远纪深呼吸了好几下才终于平静下来，然后就看着周心蓝说道：“你应该庆幸我心胸宽广，我要是兰花市人民医院院长那样的人，你在我这里也待不下去。”
周心蓝闭上嘴巴终于不吭声了，而王远纪挥了挥手示意赵大柱可以开始了。

赵大柱于是就朝着李婉容走了过去，病床上的李婉容顿时既高兴又期待，而且还很紧张。
虽然刚才李婉容一直都不敢开口，但是这里发生的一切她都看在眼里。
王远纪这个医院院长对赵大柱那么热情，态度那么友好，甚至都可以说是恭恭敬敬。
这意味着什么还需要说吗？
她现在对赵大柱的神医身份，再没有丝毫怀疑了！
content_en:
After a pause, Wang Yuting continued: "Furthermore, our hospital almost had medical accidents several times. It was my father who asked Uncle Zhao to come to the rescue to avoid the accident. Therefore, Uncle Zhao has a very good relationship with our hospital. Many doctors and nurses in the hospital know him and respect him very much."
Seeing that Wang Yuting's expression was so serious and didn't look like she was lying at all, Zhou Xinlan finally nodded and said, "Okay, I'll give you face and stop arguing with him."
But then, Zhou Xinlan said: "But he wants to treat Li Wanrong for uterine cancer here. This is definitely not possible! He is not a doctor in our hospital. According to the rules, he cannot practice medicine in our hospital. Otherwise, what if something goes wrong? Will he be held responsible or am I?"
It seemed that Zhou Xinlan would not agree to Zhao Dazhu treating diseases and saving people here, so Wang Yuting said with a smile: "I just sent a message to my father. He should be coming soon. After he comes, of course he will be in charge here, and you don't have to worry about anything."
Sure enough, as soon as Wang Yuting finished speaking, an old man in a white coat walked in from outside.
This old man is none other than Wang Yuanji, the director of Taohua County Central Hospital!
"I'll take the responsibility!"
Wang Yuanji said loudly as soon as he entered the ward, and then he quickly walked towards Zhao Dazhu with a smile.
"Uncle Zhao, why didn't you say hello when you came? If I knew you were coming to my place, I would have gone down to greet you personally!" Wang Yuanji said with a hearty smile.
Zhao Dazhu smiled and said: "I'm not here to drink tea with you and reminisce about old times, but I'm here to examine and treat the patient. After curing her, I have to go home early, so I don't want to disturb you."
"There's nothing I can do. I'm the director. I'm responsible for all the big and small things in the hospital. Even if you don't want to disturb me, you can't."
Wang Yuanji chuckled and continued: "Uncle Zhao, you can let go of treating this female patient now. I, the dean, will be responsible for everything that happens here. Uncle Zhao, you don't have to worry about anything."
"Dean, you..."
Zhou Xinlan wanted to stop him, but Wang Yuanji immediately turned to Zhou Xinlan and said, "Director Zhou, please don't always confront your boss. Isn't it because you have a falling out with your immediate boss that you can't work at Lanhua City People's Hospital? I, the dean, have said that I will bear all the responsibilities, so don't worry about it!"
If it were another doctor, he would definitely have nodded in agreement, but this Zhou Xinlan turned out to be very stubborn and said without hesitation: "Of course you say that now if nothing happens, but when something does happen, you will kick me out, the director of the oncology department, and take the blame!"
"You!"
Wang Yuanji was shaking with anger and his face turned livid.
Wang Yuting smiled bitterly and said quickly: "Dad, don't be angry. It's not like you don't know what kind of person Xinlan is, and she doesn't mean any harm. She just says what she thinks in her heart."
Wang Yuanji took several deep breaths before finally calming down. Then he looked at Zhou Xinlan and said, "You should be lucky that I have a broad mind. If I were someone like the director of Lanhua City People's Hospital, you wouldn't be able to stay here any longer."
Zhou Xinlan closed her mouth and finally fell silent, while Wang Yuanji waved his hand to indicate that Zhao Dazhu could start.
Zhao Dazhu then walked towards Li Wanrong. Li Wanrong on the hospital bed was suddenly happy, expectant, and very nervous.
Although Li Wanrong had not dared to speak just now, she saw everything that happened here.
Wang Yuanji, the hospital director, was so enthusiastic and friendly towards Zhao Dazhu that he could even be said to be respectful.
Does this mean anything more that needs to be said?
She now has no doubt about Zhao Dazhu's identity as a miracle doctor!
